members.title: A blocked payment says "Blocked" everywhere
members.objective:
## Block an unknown recipient and read every status
Click the "$12 to Mallory" chip. Wait for the agent's chat bubble to finish and for the outcome stamp to appear. The rails must block this payment, and the user must see one consistent word for it. Verify all of these: the "Allowlist" check is marked as failed and says "Mallory is not on your allowlist"; the stamp says exactly "Blocked" (not "Refused" or any other word); the new receipt for "Mallory · $12" says "Blocked"; the word "Refused" appears nowhere on the page; and there is no "Approve" button.

members.title: Over the review limit waits for a human, who can refuse
members.objective:
## Refuse a payment that needs your OK
Click the "$15 to Jordan" chip. Wait until the "Review limit" check says $15 is over $10 and needs a human, and the stamp says "Needs your OK". Verify no receipt has been printed yet for Jordan while the "Approve" and "Refuse" buttons are shown. Click "Refuse". Verify a receipt for "Jordan · $15" appears saying "Refused by you", with an id starting with "RD-", and that the Approve and Refuse buttons are gone.

members.title: Run all three shows Approved, Needs your OK, and Blocked
members.objective:
## Play every outcome back to back
Verify the page heading says "See the rails in action." Click "Run all three". First the agent's chat bubble asks to pay Alex $8; wait for the stamp, verify it says "Approved", and verify the three checks (Spending cap, Allowlist, Review limit) appeared. Next the bubble asks to pay Jordan $15; wait until the stamp says "Needs your OK" and an "Approve" button appears, then click "Approve". Next the bubble asks to pay Mallory $12; wait until the stamp says "Blocked". Verify the Receipts section now shows three receipts, each with an id starting with "RD-" and a time: "Mallory · $12" with "Blocked", "Jordan · $15" with "Approved by you", and "Alex · $8" with "Approved". Verify there is a "Now do it for real on X Layer" link.

members.title: Policy circuit shows Approved, Needs your OK, and Blocked
members.objective:
## Change the amount and recipient in demo mode
Use the "Do it for real" console on this page. Stay in "Demo (mock)" mode. Do not click Connect wallet. With the default recipient Alex and amount 12, verify the TapeOut policy circuit rule says "Needs your OK". Change the amount to 5 and verify the circuit rule says "Approved". Change the amount to 21 and verify the circuit rule says "Blocked". Set the amount back to 12, change the recipient to Mallory, and verify the circuit rule says "Blocked".
